I found one bug in the uncommitted changes, in `docs/service.py`.

**`docs/service.py:38` — `rename` has no ownership check (authorization bypass).**
- `rename` calls `self.repo.get(doc_id)` directly. Every other method (`read`, `update_body` and `delete`) goes through `self._owned(user_id, doc_id)`. `user_id` is never used in `rename`.
- Any authenticated user can rename any other user's document by passing its id.
- The id-existence protection also breaks. `_owned` raises `NotFound` for documents the user doesn't own, so the API never reveals which ids exist. With `rename`, a missing id raises `NotFound` and an existing one succeeds, so ids can be enumerated.

**Fix:** replace lines 38–39 with:
```python
document = self._owned(user_id, doc_id)
document.title = title
```

I didn't find any other bugs in the diff. I didn't check whether `rename` has callers or tests.
